import csv
from collections import defaultdict

temp_id='108335ab-9ad0-5222-b9a5-88d998152c65'
set_id='335c2ab2-c7e3-551f-8bdc-96b15c59e4a8'

data=defaultdict(dict)
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        if r["timeseries_id"] in (temp_id,set_id):
            data[r["timeseries_id"]][r["timestamp"]]=float(r["value"])

def mean_dev(date):
    devs=[]
    for ts,v in data[temp_id].items():
        d=ts[:10]
        if d!=date: continue
        hour=int(ts[11:13])
        if not (8<=hour<=18): continue
        if ts in data[set_id]:
            devs.append(v-data[set_id][ts])
    return sum(devs)/len(devs), len(devs)

m1,n1=mean_dev("2018-04-13")
m2,n2=mean_dev("2018-07-04")
print("2018-04-13 mean dev:",m1,"n:",n1)
print("2018-07-04 mean dev:",m2,"n:",n2)
print("increase" if m2>m1 else "decrease")
